## Moelis Hires Matthew Rosedale as a Managing Director in its European Financial Sponsors Business


*Appointment reflects the Firm’s continued investment in senior coverage across the region*


London


, September 21, 2026


Moelis & Company (NYSE: MC), a leading global independent investment bank, today announced the appointment of Matthew Rosedale as a Managing Director. Based in London, Matt will join Managing Directors Robert Sorrell and Edouard Debost in leading the Firm’s Financial Sponsors business across Europe.


Matt brings more than 20 years of investment banking experience and deep relationships with leading financial sponsors, advising clients across M&A, capital markets and private capital solutions. He joins Moelis from Jefferies, where he was a Managing Director in the European Financial Sponsors Group. Previously, Matt spent nearly two decades at J.P. Morgan in London and New York, on both their M&A team and Financial Sponsors Group.


Matt Prest, Head of Europe and APAC at Moelis, said, “Matt’s appointment reflects our strong commitment to the financial sponsor community. His extensive transaction experience and deep sponsor relationships across Europe add to our established senior coverage and will help us deliver the full breadth of Moelis’s capabilities to our sponsor clients as their strategic and capital needs evolve. We are delighted to welcome him to the Firm.”


## About Moelis & Company


Moelis & Company (“Moelis”) is a leading global independent investment bank that provides innovative strategic advice and solutions to a diverse client base, including corporations, governments, and financial sponsors. The Firm assists its clients in achieving their strategic goals by offering comprehensive integrated financial advisory services across all major industry sectors. Moelis’s experienced professionals advise clients on their most critical decisions, including mergers and acquisitions, recapitalizations and restructurings, capital markets transactions, secondary transactions and primary fundraising, and other corporate finance matters. The Firm serves clients from locations across North and South America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. For further information, please visit:[www.moelis.com](http://www.moelis.com/) .
